name: Copper circlet
description: A band of polished wood bound in copper at both edges and studded round, with a pointed copper plaque that rests on the brow. It serves as a focus for spellcasting.
notes: Standing on its lower edge, front on +z: an oak band 170 mm across and 25 mm tall with copper rims, eleven studs and a pointed plaque inset with wood at the front. CHECK VOLUME (box/volume x2.9): the ring encloses air. The mass of 700 g follows the reference, heavy for a circlet. `mana_focus` carries the reference's spell-focus quality and is a new quality name; Deadvox has no magic yet. Slot `hair`, the slot headbands use, so it can sit under a hat; `head` would clash with helmets. The silver circlet shares this model with its own finishes. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Dragonhide backpack
description: A squared black backpack of thick reptile hide, its front pocket covered in rows of hard raised scutes, closed under a deep strapped lid with buckles of carved bone.
notes: Standing, front toward the iso view: black hide body, lid and side pockets, a red-brown back pad, shoulder straps and hip belt (`leather-chestnut`), charcoal scutes on the front pocket and bone buckles; 360 mm wide and 520 mm tall. Point: lid straps are the two straps down the front of the lid. CHECK VOLUME (x21): the reference volume is the empty bag packed down; the model stands at its real size. The hide is `hide-dragon-black`; protection is a guess above plain leather, as the reference gives none here. Encumbrance and warmth follow the reference. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.
